messages:
sophia: Kicking off VeraBlue Therapeutics dedicated rollout (private) — proposed window Tue 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 10% for 30m then ramp. Pin runtime image=rwinf/runtime:3.2.1 and model=rwinf-gpt-2b@v2026-03-15. Need infra + security + customer-success approvals.
chen: Ack. Dedicated pool reserved (4x A100). Autoscale disabled for canary, will gate resources. KMS rotation is scheduled at 03:00 — we should avoid collision.
alex: +1 from infra side but need exact KMS key path so security can block rotations during cutover. Nina, can customer accept 02:00-04:00?
nina: Customer confirmed night window ok. They want max 2 rollback attempts and a post-cutover checkpoint at +1h. Also flag: model is int8-quantized — include potential small quality delta in release notes.
sophia: Understood. Rollback policy proposed: immediate rollback to model v2026-02-12 if p95 latency >200ms OR error-rate spikes >2% sustained for 10m. I'll put this in the runbook.
ops-oncall: Oncall team will be standing by. If KV cache miss rate spikes >3x, escalate to eng-runtime immediately.
deploybot: deploy started: canary slice=vb-tenant-1 image=rwinf/runtime:3.2.1 model=rwinf-gpt-2b@v2026-03-15
status: canary deployed to 2 hosts
monitoring: latency, error-rate, token-cost
link: https://deploys.redwood/dev/3942001111
chen: Canary metrics first 12m — p95 145ms -> 160ms, error-rate 0.4% -> 0.6%, KV cache miss steady. No rollback needed.
sophia: Proceeding to ramp to 50% over 15m. Autoscale remains disabled for the window.
nina: Customer team will run smoke tests against prompt suite A/B during ramp. Report in 10m.
alex: Security confirms KMS rotation paused for the window, +approve for cutover. :thumbsup:
deploybot: ramp started: target=50% expected_duration=15m status=ramping
chen: After ramp (20m): p95 170ms, error-rate 1.1%, token-cost up ~6% (quantization effect expected). Observability noted unrelated reindex job causing noise.
ops-oncall: Noted a small disk I/O spike on the dedicated nodes. Watching — if disk I/O >70% for 5m we'll pause the shift.
sophia: Traffic at 50% stable for 20m. Planning to go to 100% in 10m if no regressions. Final approvals from @alex, @nina, @ops-oncall?
alex: approved
nina: approved from customer side
ops-oncall: standby ok
deploybot: rollout complete: traffic=100% timestamp=3942001215 notes: model pinned v2026-03-15 runtime=3.2.1 post-check: p95=175ms error-rate=1.0% within thresholds runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/eng-releases/vb-rollout-3942001111
sophia: Great work. Follow-ups: schedule triage with customer in +2h and open an RC for minor QA drift noted. Thanks team :party:
